claim: Collective API constructs work intent and forwards it to enqueue processing.
NCCL loads and initializes external network interfaces and assigns one to a communicator.
Communicator initialization prepares distributed execution resources.
Enqueue checks and grouping prepare communication launch work.
Runtime tuning evaluates communication execution choices.
NCCL network transport connects execution to selected network operations.
Network interface defines registration, asynchronous operations, and request testing.
NCCL benchmark tests are maintained in the separate nccl-tests project.
Plugin adapts NCCL network operations to libfabric and describes provider requirements.
Plugin initialization applies explicit protocol selection before platform/runtime defaults.
SENDRECV submits tagged operations, handles retryable EAGAIN, and progresses requests through CQ testing.
RDMA protocol implements remote-memory transport operations separately from SENDRECV.
OFI_NCCL_PROTOCOL permits SENDRECV and RDMA values.
Functional checks require the documented MPI and hardware environment.
Source installation has explicit build dependencies and configuration requirements.
libfabric exposes application-oriented fabric interfaces across providers.
EFA provider registers getinfo and fabric operations.
Core fi_getinfo performs API/provider discovery before fabric resource construction.
Endpoint interfaces expose operation and resource contracts.
Domains scope resource allocation and memory-registration operations.
Tagged inline API dispatches sends and receives through provider operation tables.
Registration describes memory access and heterogeneous-memory attributes.
EFA RDM tagged operation table binds public API to provider message implementation.
EFA efa and efa-direct fabrics have different capabilities; tagged messages use the efa path.
Completion reads distinguish pending entries and errors retrieved with fi_cq_readerr.
EFA RDM completion handling progresses provider operations.
